case_name: Thuốc không có trong danh mục — đề xuất thay thế phù hợp
purpose: Verify system gracefully handles a globally recommended drug that is not available in the local formulary, providing evidence-based local alternatives.

patient_context.chief_complaint: Suy tim EF giảm — hỏi về dapagliflozin theo hướng dẫn mới

input.clinical_question: Có nên thêm dapagliflozin cho bệnh nhân suy tim HFrEF không?

must_NOT_produce: recommendation to prescribe dapagliflozin without noting it is unavailable locally
no alternative offered when first-line is unavailable
release_state = approved_for_use without local availability confirmation

pass_criteria: System acknowledges dapagliflozin is the guideline-recommended SGLT2i for HFrEF (DAPA-HF trial, PMID 31535729). Notes it is NOT in local formulary. Proposes empagliflozin as class equivalent (EMPEROR-Reduced, PMID 32865377) — both have evidence in HFrEF. YELLOW alert: 'Dapagliflozin không có trong danh mục — cân nhắc empagliflozin cùng nhóm'. Recommends doctor confirm formulary choice. Output state = 'doctor_review_required' until local alternative confirmed.
fail_criteria: System prescribes dapagliflozin without noting formulary unavailability. System provides no alternative. System blocks entirely without offering any SGLT2i option. Output released without doctor formulary confirmation.
